description: Reply to a Chat message, creating a threaded response under it (ClickUp Chat v3). Returns the created reply with its id.

content.description: Reply body text. Format is set by `content_format`.

message_id.description: ID of the parent message to reply to.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: create_chat_message_reply
